title: Entrevista com um ator
grammarPoint: Past simple negatives and questions (did / didn't)

text.title: Four Questions for Jake Rivera
paragraphs: Jake Rivera plays a young doctor in the hit series Night Shift. We talked to him about his first big [[role]] and his life before TV.
Did you always want to be an actor? "No, I didn't! As a kid, I wanted to be a soccer player. I started acting in high school, almost [[by accident]]."
How did you get the role in Night Shift? "My agent called me on a Monday, and the [[audition]] was on Tuesday. I didn't have time to prepare, so I was really nervous. But I got the part!"
What did you do before the show? "I worked as a [[waiter]] in New York for three years. I didn't [[earn]] much money, but I met a lot of interesting people."
Did you watch the first episode with your family? "Yes, I did. We watched it at my parents' house. My mom cried, and my dad didn't say anything. He was too [[proud]]!"

role.note: Também se diz part: "I got the part" = "consegui o papel".

earn.note: to earn money = ganhar dinheiro trabalhando; to win = ganhar um jogo ou prêmio

grammar.title: Past simple: negativa e pergunta com did
explanation: Na negativa e na pergunta do past simple, usamos o auxiliar did, e o verbo principal volta para a forma básica. O did já mostra que é passado, então o verbo não precisa mostrar de novo.
Negativa: sujeito + didn't (did not) + verbo básico. I didn't have time, e não I didn't had time. My dad didn't say anything, e não didn't said.
Pergunta: Did + sujeito + verbo básico? Did you watch the first episode? Respostas curtas: Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.
Com palavras de pergunta (what, where, how, when, why), a ordem é: palavra + did + sujeito + verbo básico. What did you do? How did you get the role?
Exceção: o verbo to be não usa did. Na negativa: I wasn't nervous, they weren't at home. Na pergunta: Were you nervous? Was it hard?

exercises.prompt: O que o Jake queria ser quando era criança?
exercises.explanation: Ele diz: "As a kid, I wanted to be a soccer player." Nos EUA, futebol é soccer.

exercises.statement: Jake had a lot of time to prepare for the audition.
exercises.explanation: Falso: "I didn't have time to prepare, so I was really nervous."

exercises.prompt: O que o Jake fazia antes da série?
exercises.explanation: Ele diz: "I worked as a waiter in New York for three years."

exercises.statement: Jake's dad cried when they watched the first episode.
exercises.explanation: Falso: quem chorou foi a mãe. O pai não disse nada: "my dad didn't say anything".
Negativa no passado: didn't + verbo básico (have).

exercises.sentence: ___ you watch the first episode with your family?
exercises.explanation: Pergunta no passado: Did + sujeito + verbo básico.

exercises.prompt: Depois de did, use o verbo na forma básica.
exercises.sentence: Where did you ___ before the show?
exercises.explanation: Did já indica o passado, então o verbo fica na forma básica: did you work, e não did you worked.
Did + sujeito + verbo básico: Did you get the part? Depois de did, nunca usamos o passado (got).

exercises.prompt: Coloque as palavras na ordem certa.
exercises.explanation: Palavra de pergunta + did + sujeito + verbo básico: What did you do before the show?
